title: Help
description: Find a task, follow the steps, or watch a short video. Practical help for using the Nostr WoT extension.

account.title: Create a new account
steps: Install the extension, open it, and choose Create New.
Save all 24 recovery words in order and complete the backup check.
Set a vault password and auto-lock, finish setup, then choose Get Started.

subAccounts.title: Add another identity
steps: Make sure you have saved your main recovery phrase first. Open the account selector and choose Add Account → Create New.
Name the sub-account. Keep the suggested derivation path unless you need a specific one. It uses your existing main recovery phrase.
Finish setup and use the account selector to switch identities. Back up the recovery phrase and each account’s derivation path.

backup.title: Back up your account
steps: Select the account, then open Settings → Security to export its key or backup. Keep it private; never paste a private key into a website.
Store the backup securely. For a derived identity, keep both the recovery phrase and its derivation path.
To restore, choose Add Account → Import Key or Backup. Check that the restored public key matches your original account.

remove.title: Remove an account
steps: Save a recoverable backup first, including the derivation path for a sub-account.
Open the account selector and choose the account’s × remove icon.
Read the confirmation, check the account name, then choose Remove. This removes the local account, not its published Nostr posts.

approvals.title: Review an app’s request
steps: When a site asks to connect or use your account, open the extension’s pending request.
Check the requesting site, action, and content or destination. Use the code button if you want to inspect the raw event.
Choose Approve or Deny. Use an arrow menu only when you want to remember a decision; check Recent activity afterward.

permissions.title: Change global and site rules
steps: Open Permissions → Global rules to set defaults for connected sites.
To change one site, visit it, open the extension, then choose Permissions → Site rules.

Inherited rules are gray. Site overrides replace matching global rules, but a broader Deny rule can still block a request. Edit a rule or confirm Reset site overrides to return to the global defaults.

authentication.title: Review saved sign-in permissions
steps: Open Permissions for the active account, then Backend authentication or Relay authentication.
Review saved backend decisions, or select which connected sites may authenticate to a relay. Revoke access you no longer want.
Default backend auth is optional and off initially. It covers same-origin and approved registry pairs; check the policy link before enabling it.

wallet.title: Connect a Lightning wallet
steps: Open Wallet and choose Quick Setup, NWC, or LNbits. Quick Setup uses a custodial provider that holds the funds.
For NWC, paste a wallet connection URI. For LNbits, enter the instance URL and wallet Admin API key. Keep those credentials private.
Connect and check the wallet balance. Use Deposit to create an invoice when you want to add sats.

zaps.title: Send a zap
steps: Connect a wallet with enough balance, then choose the zap or Lightning button in a compatible Nostr app.
Choose an amount. Review the recipient, sats, fees where shown, and any signing or payment requests before approving.
Check the result in wallet activity. If you enable payment auto-approval, set a spending limit you are comfortable with.

appearance.title: Change the appearance
steps: Open Settings → Appearance and language.
Choose a light, dark, or system appearance and a theme from the available options.
Return to the dashboard to check the result. You can change the theme again from the same settings.

language.title: Change the language
steps: Open Settings → Appearance and language → Language.
Choose your language, then select Confirm. Closing the picker without confirming keeps the previous language.
The interface updates and remembers your choice. Use the settings gear to return if you need to change it back.

security.title: Set a password and auto-lock
steps: Open Settings → Security.
Use the password control to protect the local vault, then choose a timed auto-lock interval.
Lock the vault when finished. Keep your recovery backup separately; the vault password does not replace it.

import.title: Import an existing account
steps: Choose Add Account → Import Key or Backup. Paste your private key or recovery phrase, or load a backup file; the format is detected automatically.
Enter the backup privately in the extension. Check the restored public key before using the account.

switch.title: Switch accounts
steps: Open the account selector and select the identity you want to use.
Check the active account before approving a request. If a website still shows the old identity, sign out there and reconnect.

receive.title: Receive sats
steps: Open Wallet → Deposit and enter the amount to create a Lightning invoice.
Share the invoice with the payer. Check wallet activity and balance to confirm it was paid.

limits.title: Change payment auto-approval
steps: Open Wallet → Settings and review the auto-approval threshold.
Choose a threshold for each individual payment, not a total spending budget. Use zero to require confirmation for every payment. Review your wallet activity regularly.

loginFailed.title: I cannot sign in
steps: Unlock the extension, check the active account, and look for a pending request. Review any error before retrying.
Check Site rules and the separate backend or relay permissions for that account. If the request uses an unsupported format, share the error with the site’s developers, never your keys.

denied.title: A request is denied
steps: Visit the affected site and open Permissions → Site rules. Check site overrides and inherited global denials.
Change only the rule you intended to change. Authentication has separate permissions; resetting site overrides does not remove those decisions.

walletFailed.title: My wallet will not connect
steps: Check that your wallet is online and that you used the matching connection method: NWC URI or LNbits URL and Admin API key.
For NWC, check connection permissions and expiry in your wallet. Never share the connection secret or API key when asking for help.

zapFailed.title: A zap failed
steps: Check wallet history before retrying so you do not pay twice. Confirm sufficient balance, including fees.
Unlock the extension and check the wallet connection and site permission. If the site cannot detect WebLN, refresh it. Keep the error text if it still fails.
